phase_1.title: Phase 1 · Hoyt RX-8 Energy Draw & Nocking
phase_1.description: Drawing the bowstring stores elastic potential energy across the 749 mm power stroke of the Hoyt Carbon RX-8 Ultra limbs.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · Peak Tension & Mechanical Anchor
phase_2.description: At full draw, eccentric cams load elastic limb energy and roll over into a high-let-off valley before release, holding the 400 gr Carbon Arrow (340 Spine) projectile aligned on the launch datum.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · Crisp Trigger / Finger Release
phase_3.description: Disengaging the latch frees the taut bowstring cleanly without lateral torque, initiating forward energy transfer.

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Elastic Limb Recovery & Acceleration
phase_4.description: Stored strain energy unwinds rapidly along the rail, accelerating the projectile toward 104 m/s.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Rest Clearance & Fletching Spin
phase_5.description: The shaft clears the launcher with 140 J of kinetic energy as helical fletching initiates aerodynamic stabilization.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Brace-Height Stop & Vibration Decay
phase_6.description: String stops and riser dampeners absorb residual oscillation cleanly to preserve quiet acoustic discipline.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Safety Engagement & Next-Shot Prep
phase_7.description: The release assembly resets automatically, preparing the Hoyt RX-8 for the next precision launch out to 90 m.

zh.headline: 霍伊特 Carbon RX-8 Ultra 碳纤维复合弓：2024 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 霍伊特 Carbon RX-8 Ultra 采用 50 束高模量单向碳纤维铺层制成的中空双管桁架弓把，在 1.99 kg 轻量质量下实现极高抗扭刚度；HBX Xact 双凸轮提供 1/4 英寸微调拉距与 80% 省力谷底。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Hoyt RX-8 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 2024 年问世的 霍伊特 Carbon RX-8 Ultra 碳纤维复合弓 由美国霍伊特弓箭公司（Hoyt Archery）主导研制，定位为经典的中空碳纤维复合弓。霍伊特自 2010 年推出首款 Carbon Matrix 中空碳管弓把以来，RX 系列连续十余年成为现代高精度碳纤复合弓的工业标杆。
霍伊特 Carbon RX-8 Ultra 采用 50 束高模量单向碳纤维铺层制成的中空双管桁架弓把，在 1.99 kg 轻量质量下实现极高抗扭刚度；HBX Xact 双凸轮提供 1/4 英寸微调拉距与 80% 省力谷底。 整件装备总长 965 mm（轴距 34 in / 864 mm）、空重 1.99 kg，成为同期冷兵弓弩领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。2024 年，美国霍伊特弓箭公司（Hoyt Archery）推出了划时代的霍伊特 Carbon RX-8 Ultra 碳纤维复合弓。霍伊特自 2010 年推出首款 Carbon Matrix 中空碳管弓把以来，RX 系列连续十余年成为现代高精度碳纤复合弓的工业标杆。 它的核心设计聚焦于中空碳纤维管状桁架弓把，低温手持温暖且抗扭刚度卓越，奠定了其在冷兵弓弩发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高刚度中空桁架主弓把

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 霍伊特 Carbon RX-8 Ultra 碳纤维复合弓 的机械灵魂在于其「HBX Xact 双偏心凸轮滑轮组 · 80% 省力比碳管弓把」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，偏心双凸轮滑轮组储存弯片弹性势能，满拉后进入低拉力省力谷底等待撒放，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用高模量单向碳纤维铺层与 CNC 阳极氧化铝合金精加工而成。HBX Xact 双同步凸轮组支持 1/4 in 精密拉距微调与 80% 省力比，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。霍伊特 Carbon RX-8 Ultra 碳纤维复合弓 采用HBX Xact 双偏心凸轮滑轮组 · 80% 省力比碳管弓把。在每个击发周期中，偏心双凸轮滑轮组储存弯片弹性势能，满拉后进入低拉力省力谷底等待撒放。借助高模量单向碳纤维铺层与 CNC 阳极氧化铝合金工艺与高强度配合，实现了HBX Xact 双同步凸轮组支持 1/4 in 精密拉距微调与 80% 省力比。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主弓弦与同步分弦缆绳

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 400 gr Carbon Arrow (340 Spine) 弹药规格与 749 mm（29.5 in 拉距 · 6.75 in 弓档），最高工作膛压约 0.5 MPa，可赋予弹头 104 m/s 的出膛初速与 140 J 动能，有效作用距离达 90 米。
内膛技术特点方面，跌落式箭台导向，依靠三片螺旋羽片产生气动自旋稳定。同时，WireWRX 预拉伸弓弦与分叉式分弦滑杆消除凸轮侧倾力矩，令其在 10 箭/分（单发手工搭箭） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 749 毫米身管与 400 gr Carbon Arrow (340 Spine) 口径，霍伊特 Carbon RX-8 Ultra 碳纤维复合弓 实现了每秒 104 米的初速与 90 米有效射程。跌落式箭台导向，依靠三片螺旋羽片产生气动自旋稳定，展现了卓越的工程平衡。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高储能复合/反曲弹性弓片组

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 5 发容量的箭壶本体与碳纤箭矢组与 171 mm 膛轴设计，霍伊特 Carbon RX-8 Ultra 碳纤维复合弓 将单发后坐冲量控制在 2.7 N·s 水平。集成燕尾槽瞄具接口与底置重心减震器抑制撒放余震。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-91）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 5 发容量的箭壶本体与碳纤箭矢组与出色的整体工效，集成燕尾槽瞄具接口与底置重心减震器抑制撒放余震。欢迎在 BAY-91 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 霍伊特 Carbon RX-8 Ultra 碳纤维复合弓 的机械魅力。

en.headline: Hoyt Carbon RX-8 Ultra: The 2024 Mechanical Legend
en.deck: The Hoyt Carbon RX-8 Ultra pairs a hand-laid hollow dual-tube carbon truss riser with HBX Xact binary cams offering 1/4-inch draw-length micro-indexing, 80% let-off, and dead-in-hand vibration damping at 1.99 kg. Preserved in 1:1 interactive 3D CAD scale across all 20 functional assemblies in BAY-91.

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Hoyt RX-8
paragraphs: Introduced in 2024 by Hoyt Archery in United States, the Hoyt Carbon RX-8 Ultra emerged as a defining Carbon-Tube Compound Bow. Building on Hoyt’s pioneering 2010 Carbon Matrix hollow-tube architecture, the RX series established carbon-truss risers as a benchmark in modern compound bow engineering.

The Hoyt Carbon RX-8 Ultra pairs a hand-laid hollow dual-tube carbon truss riser with HBX Xact binary cams offering 1/4-inch draw-length micro-indexing, 80% let-off, and dead-in-hand vibration damping at 1.99 kg. Measuring 965 mm (34 in / 864 mm Axle-to-Axle) at an unloaded weight of 1.99 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Archery & Crossbow class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 2024, Hoyt Archery of United States introduced the Hoyt Carbon RX-8 Ultra. Building on Hoyt’s pioneering 2010 Carbon Matrix hollow-tube architecture, the RX series established carbon-truss risers as a benchmark in modern compound bow engineering. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Hollow dual-tube carbon truss riser delivers high torsional stiffness at 1.99 kg — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Hoyt Carbon RX-8 Ultra sits its HBX Xact Binary Eccentric Cam System · 80% Let-Off Hollow Carbon Riser. Throughout every firing cycle, eccentric cams load elastic limb energy and roll over into a high-let-off valley before release, containing 0.5 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in high-modulus unidirectional carbon fiber and CNC anodized aluminum, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, HBX Xact synchronized binary cams enable 1/4-inch draw indexing and 80% let-off, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Hoyt Carbon RX-8 Ultra relies on HBX Xact Binary Eccentric Cam System · 80% Let-Off Hollow Carbon Riser. During each cycle, eccentric cams load elastic limb energy and roll over into a high-let-off valley before release. Machined from high-modulus unidirectional carbon fiber and CNC anodized aluminum, it delivers standout engineering reliability: HBX Xact synchronized binary cams enable 1/4-inch draw indexing and 80% let-off.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 400 gr Carbon Arrow (340 Spine) with 749 mm (29.5 in Draw Length · 6.75 in Brace Height), the Hoyt Carbon RX-8 Ultra develops 104 m/s muzzle velocity and 140 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 90 meters.

Internally, Drop-away launcher guidance; helical fletching induces aerodynamic arrow spin stabilization. Combined with its 10 arrows/min (manual nock) tempo, Pre-stretched cable buss and split-limb geometry neutralize lateral cam lean, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 400 gr Carbon Arrow (340 Spine) through its 749 millimeter bore, the Hoyt Carbon RX-8 Ultra achieves 104 meters per second and 90 meters of effective reach. Drop-away launcher guidance; helical fletching induces aerodynamic arrow spin stabilization.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 5-round quiver body & arrow assembly with a 171 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 2.7 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Integrated dovetail sight mount and low-CG stabilizer quell post-shot oscillation.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-91), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
acts.audioScript: Act Four: Engineering Legacy. Pairing its 5-round quiver body & arrow assembly with disciplined recoil geometry, Integrated dovetail sight mount and low-CG stabilizer quell post-shot oscillation. Explore BAY-91 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the Hoyt Carbon RX-8 Ultra.
